construction.implementation_origin: New, isolated implementation using synthetic fixtures

shared_schema.input: schema_version, document, fields, catalog, search; fixture_label is optional metadata
shared_schema.fields: Unique names and non-overlapping case-insensitive aliases; types string, number, boolean; explicit required flag
shared_schema.catalog: Unique id, name, description, category, tags, finite nonnegative price, boolean in_stock
shared_schema.search: Typed field references: query_field required; max_price_field, category_field, in_stock_field optional; limit 1..100; min_score in (0,1]
shared_schema.output: schema_version, status (ok or needs_input), extraction, search; errors have status error and error message
shared_schema.validation: Shared Schema layer validates input, extraction handoff and ranked catalog results
shared_schema.spans: Zero-based half-open Python Unicode character offsets in original document, including original newline widths
shared_schema.missing: Null value and span; missing_fields includes absent or blank optional and required fields; missing_required is the required subset

cross_stage_handoffs: Extract validates typed values against source_text and document spans.
Search revalidates extraction and obtains query, maximum price, category and stock solely from extracted field values.
Missing required fields or unusable search query skip ranking and return needs_input with exit code 0.

behavior.extraction: Deterministic line-oriented label: value parsing with normalized aliases, whitespace trimming, strict decimals and yes/no/true/false booleans. Unknown labels ignored; repeated known labels rejected.
behavior.search: Unicode token normalization, explicit small synonym dictionary, stop words, prefix matching and bounded fuzzy spelling similarity; field-weighted average query coverage; structured exact category, stock and maximum-price filters
behavior.ranking: Score descending, price ascending, product id ascending; per-term explanation and pre-limit total_matches
behavior.errors: File, JSON and validation failures print one JSON object and exit 2
behavior.fixtures: All document and catalog data is synthetic

test_outcomes.cli_error_cases: Missing input file, malformed JSON and invalid argument counts produce one JSON error and exit 2
